limitations: The full P056 comparison is eight family/baseline reports (four families against P001 and the structural predecessor) plus two predeclared cold controls; the current admitted registry has 53 rows and 181 stage groups, for 144720 declared pairs total.

P047 and P050 individual refresh datasets are analyzed independently; aggregation adds no statistics recomputation.
P007 provides counters without sampled CPU percentages; no CPU-profile attribution is permitted.
Historical P047-P055 statuses and dispositions are validated against their published completion/evidence records and cannot be reclassified by P056.
